prerequisites: Recommended: competencies taught in the basic modules for Practical Informatics.
Recommended: programming experience in Python and C++.

learning_outcomes.text: The students can explain and apply the necessary methods of content-based analysis of image and video data; this includes methods of image and moving image processing and machine learning.
The students can design software systems for image recognition and implement them based on Deep Learning libraries (Caffe, Tensorflow, ...).
The students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently recognizing, formulating, and solving problems.

syllabus_topics: Basics of image and video processing
Basics of deep neural networks (CNN, LSTM)

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points achieved)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Oral exam (individual examination) OR written exam

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution for at least two of the exercise assignments. Grading is from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science program. The examination performance can be an oral exam (individual examination) or a written exam.
